map.输入负载力、运动速度和传动效率，计算所需功率并推荐电机配置: Enter the load force, motion speed, and transmission efficiency to compute the required power and recommend a motor configuration.
map.由负载力 F、运动速度 v 与传动效率 η 计算所需功率，从标准电机功率序列推荐: From load force F, motion speed v, and transmission efficiency η compute the required power, recommend a motor rating from the standard series, and estimate rated torque T and current, for motor selection in mechanical drive systems.
map.💡 理论功率 P=F×v/1000；选型功率=理论功率÷η×SF×工况系数（先按: 💡 Theoretical power P = F×v/1000; selected power = theoretical ÷ η × SF × duty factor (first convert to motor shaft power by transmission efficiency, then add safety margin and duty factor); round motor up to the standard power.
map.传动效率参考：齿轮箱0.95、皮带0.90、丝杠0.85、蜗轮0.70: Transmission efficiency reference: gearbox 0.95, belt 0.90, screw 0.85, worm 0.70.
map.变频电机需预留10-15%余量，频繁启动需增大安全系数: VFD motors need a 10–15% margin; frequent starting needs a larger safety factor.
map.📚 深度解析：工业设备功率匹配（理论功率/配电机/扭矩）: 📚 Deep Dive: Industrial Equipment Power Matching (theoretical power / motor / torque)
map.传动设计：输入阻力、速度、效率与安全系数，算理论功率并配电机: Drive design: enter resistance, speed, efficiency, and safety factor to compute theoretical power and match a motor.
map.过载校核：利用率判断电机是否偏大/偏小: Overload check: utilization reveals whether the motor is oversized / undersized.
map.扭矩校核：由功率与转速算输出扭矩与电流: Torque check: from power and speed compute output torque and current.
map.算法：理论功率 P = F×v/1000（kW）；选用功率 Psel = P÷η: Algorithm: theoretical power P = F×v/1000 (kW); selected power Psel = P÷η×SF×duty factor (first convert to motor shaft power by transmission efficiency, then add safety and duty factors); round motor up to the standard series; output torque T = Pmotor×1000/ω (ω=2π×1500/60); rated current ≈ Pmotor×1000/(380×1.732×0.85×0.85).
Example: resistance 2000 N, speed 0.5 m/s, η=0.85, SF=1.5, duty 1.0 → theoretical 1.0 kW, selected 1.76 kW, motor 2.2 kW, output torque 14.01 N·m, current 4.6 A, utilization 80.2% (reasonable). If resistance 5000 N, speed 1.0, η0.9, SF1.2, duty1.2 → theoretical 5.0 kW, selected 8.00 kW, motor 11 kW, torque 70.03 N·m, current 23.1 A.
map.一般 50~90% 为合理区间；<30% 电机偏大费电、>90% 余量不足易过载: Generally 50%~90% is the reasonable range; <30% means an oversized, wasteful motor, >90% means insufficient margin and easy overload, so adjust the rating.
